display_name: Record a structured workstream progress assessment
description: Appends one Phase-B assessment for one stable workstream in deployment-native state. It retains the objective citation, raw metrics, measured delta, honest assessment, recommendation, independent-critique status, escalations, and optional Phase-A run citation. It is append-only and intentionally non-retryable because a blind retry could duplicate an assessment.
embedding_description: Persist a queryable structured Phase-B assessment for one stable workstream, with objective citation, current metrics, measured delta, evidence-based assessment, recommendation, independent-critique status, escalations, and an optional cited Phase-A run, instead of appending a markdown review entry.
